title: Durable attestation store
description: profiles/<person-slug>/attestations.json. Facts the user has stated about their own experience. Written only by scripts (`cvt answers-apply`, `cvt approve`, `cvt attest`). Reused by every later run for the same person. Truthfulness: an attestation is the only evidence besides CV text that a tailored claim may cite.

next_seq.description: Next numeric suffix for att-NNN. Starts at 1; never reused, even after revocation.

kind.description: global = may be cited by any item; role_label = items whose role_label matches (case-insensitive substring); items = explicit list; unresolved = the user's scope was ambiguous and a scope question must be asked before use.

role_label.description: Selector value when kind=role_label, e.g. 'SRE'. '' otherwise.

item_ids.description: Resolved profile engagement/work IDs. Filled by scripts for kind=role_label|items; [] for global/unresolved.

description.description: The user's scope words, e.g. 'the SRE related cv items'.

item_id.description: Profile ID being corrected, or '' when type != correction.

claim.description: Normalized claim, e.g. 'Istio', 'SLOs and error budgets', 'Mindgeek dates are 2016 - 2017'.

terms.description: Exact terms/numbers this attestation licenses in tailored text, e.g. ['SLO', 'SLOs', 'error budget', 'error budgets']. The provenance validator only accepts these terms (plus synonyms) from this attestation.

detail.description: Extra context the user gave (role, project, number). '' if none. Never expanded by AI.

placement.description: Where the claim may appear. skills = skills block only (default for a bare skill without a role).

verbatim.description: The user's exact words that produced this attestation.

question_id.description: q-N it answered, or '' for unsolicited statements.

status.description: proposed = parsed but not yet approved at checkpoint 2 (usable only in its own run, only with --draft or before approval); active = approved, reusable by all runs; revoked = never usable.

caveat.description: One-line defensibility note shown once to the user, or ''.
